|errata_history=This is the original printed text. Other versions: [[Tatooine: Mos Eisley (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata)]] (PC-E1), [[Tatooine: Mos Eisley (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2), [[Tatooine: Mos Eisley (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, the current text). The image is the Virtual Block 1 release-sheet slip (the art area is blank; Interior and Exterior icons on both sides; slip number 71 at the bottom right).
* '''Original''' (this page): as printed on the Virtual Block 1 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf#page=6 Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 6, slip 71. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf#page=6 Internet Archive]</ref>: an interior and exterior site on both sides. Dark Side: “Once per turn, when a player's Landing Craft takes off or lands here, that player may retrieve 1 Force” Light Side: “Immune to Revolution. If a stormtrooper here, you must first use 2 Force to deploy a weapon or device at same or adjacent site.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Tatooine: Mos Eisley (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee card image, dated 25 February 2013 on the PC image server<ref name="srv-Virtual1-Dark">Players Committee card image server, directory listing of <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/</code>, every card image dated 25 February 2013: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034533/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A Internet Archive capture of 18 August 2019]. The files are byte for byte the ones still served today (research R6, 10–11 November 2026).</ref>: “Once per turn, when a player's Landing Craft takes off or lands here, that player may retrieve 1 Force. / Immune to Revolution. If a stormtrooper here, you must first use 2 Force to deploy a weapon or device at same or adjacent site.” The server date is the date of a bulk upload of the whole folder: the image may have been made earlier, but it is placed at the date it can be shown to exist (Bill, 11 November 2026). '''What changed:''' nothing: the original text and icons (Interior and Exterior on both sides). A repeat of an earlier text is a version of its own (wiki versions rulings, 11 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Tatooine: Mos Eisley (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (cover “official text as of 27 April 2013”; Dark Side, p. 48)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=48, page 48. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=48 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Once per turn, when a player's Landing Craft takes off or lands here, that player may retrieve 1 Force. / Immune to Revolution. If a stormtrooper here, you must first use 2 Force to deploy a weapon or device at same or adjacent site.” '''What changed:''' nothing: the original text, with the Interior icon on both sides. A repeat of an earlier text is a version of its own (wiki versions rulings, 11 November 2026).
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Tatooine: Mos Eisley (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata 3)]]): errata posted on the Players Committee forum on 27 March 2014, effective immediately<ref name="forum-p874174">Players Committee forum, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574, now titled “Current Rulings Archive August 2012 - December 2015”), post by Lukes Bionic Hand, 27 March 2014: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=40#p874174 p874174] (read 9–11 November 2026)</ref>: “The Interior icon on both sides of this location is considered stricken.” The post gives the reason: every other version of this location is exterior only. '''What changed:''' the Interior icon is gone from both sides, so the site is now exterior only. The game text did not change.
